create_OpenAIDataset_from_args: create an OpenAIDataset from argparse namespace with dataset path and prompt count
load_OpenAIDataset_with_tokenizer: load OpenAI-format JSONL dataset rows using a tokenizer for prompt length estimation
sample_openai_requests_from_jsonl: sample OpenAI-compatible chat completion requests from a JSONL file
